summary_brief: 2026年4月20日，AI Agent生态出现"发现层复苏+叙事重心迁移"双重信号。今日最大新变化并非来自被监控的核心仓库活动，而来自发现管道——open-webui（132K⭐）、hermes-agent（105K⭐）、ragflow（78K⭐）等超大规模开源AI应用同日被标记为高优先级候选，标志着发现关注点从"框架内部工程"（SDK统一化、测试基础设施）向"终端用户级应用"迁移。延续趋势方面：①SDK生产化进程仍在深化（Anthropic SDK SessionStore多后端适配器的企业采纳在持续扩散）；②跨平台兼容性问题（macOS/Intel）在OpenClaw生态内继续收敛；③安全修复仍是多项目共同优先项。新增推进点：①OpenBB进入发现视野，代表AI Agent向金融垂直领域深度渗透（量化分析+投研报告）；②中国开发者社区驱动的LlamaFactory和hello-agents同步出现，显示本土AI Agent生态的自生长能力；③lobehub（AI Agent Hub）和JeecgBoot（RAG+AI应用）代表低代码/无代码AI Agent平台的持续兴起。整体而言，生态叙事焦点正从4月13日以来的"SDK工程成熟化"向"应用层扩张"切换，但核心仓库的活动信号密度尚未反映这一转变——今日更像是发现视角下的"蓄水池补充"而非生态本身的范式跃迁。

engineering_signals.title: AI 代码助手的纵深安全防护成为工程重点
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenDevin 一天内修复两处敏感信息泄露（API 密钥日志泄露、WebSocket session 泄露），Vercel CLI 强制环境变量敏感化存储，Shopify 插件集成 WCAG 无障碍标准。安全已从被动修复转向主动防御（纵深策略、默认安全）。

engineering_signals.title: 主流项目加速 V0→V1 大版本迁移与架构重构
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenDevin 移除 4500+ 行废弃代码的 agenthub 包，Mem0 发布 OpenClaw V3 迁移路径，Shopify 推出首个电商主题技能包——多个项目同步推进大版本迁移，表明 AI Agent 框架正进入成熟期，从快速迭代转向架构稳定化。

engineering_signals.title: GitHub Actions 运行时强制升级至 Node.js 24，触发生态连锁适配压力
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: GitHub 将在 2026 年 6 月强制将 Actions 运行时从 Node.js 20 升级到 24，依赖旧版本的 Action（如 claude-code-action、setup-bun）面临紧迫的适配窗口，这将推动 CI/CD 工具链全面升级。

engineering_signals.title: 跨语言追踪标准化与可观测性基础设施完善
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: LangChain Python 与 JavaScript 实现 tracer metadata 继承行为统一，AgentScope 新增 thinking/non-thinking 模型统一支持，Phoenix 引入 Claude Opus 4.7——可观测性和模型支持的一致性需求正在推动跨语言 SDK 的深度对齐。

release_signals.title: Codex 权限沙箱与插件生态重大升级
release_signals.why_it_matters: Codex v0.122.0 引入了文件系统权限的 glob deny-read 策略、平台沙箱强制执行、隔离执行模式，以及跨仓库插件源和 MCP 服务器环境配置，这是 AI 代码助手安全性与可扩展性的重要里程碑。

release_signals.title: AgentScope 多模态与 DeepResearch 增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 Tablestore 内存支持、本地多媒体 base64 转换、Anthropic 模型 token 计数优化，以及对 thinking/non-thinking 模型的统一支持，扩展了 AI Agent 的记忆与多模态处理能力。

release_signals.title: Vercel 环境变量默认敏感化
release_signals.why_it_matters: Vercel CLI 现在将 Production 和 Preview 环境变量默认为敏感类型（加密存储且不可回读），并支持团队级策略强制执行，显著提升了部署安全性。

release_signals.title: Phoenix PXI 合规与 Claude Opus 4.7 支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 PXI 同意和追踪共享控制，并引入 Claude Opus 4.7 到 Playground，强化了 AI 可观测性平台的合规性与模型支持能力。

release_signals.title: Mem0 OpenClaw 聊天式配置与 V3 迁移
release_signals.why_it_matters: 通过对话式配置流程降低了用户入门门槛，升级至 mem0ai 3.0.1 并清理废弃配置项，推动用户向 V3 API 迁移。

releases.summary:
## Mem0 Node SDK (v3.0.1)

**Release date:** 2026-04-20
**Package:** [`mem0ai`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mem0ai) on npm
**npm tag:** `ts-v3.0.1`

## Summary

Patch release that fixes telemetry's reported `client_version` drifting from the actual package version. Both telemetry clients (`MemoryClient` and OSS `Memory`) now always report the installed package version, driven by `package.json` at build time.

## Bug Fixes

- **Telemetry:** Inject SDK version into telemetry at build time via esbuild's `define`, replacing the two hardcoded `let version = "..."` strings in `mem0-ts/src/client/telemetry.ts` and `mem0-ts/src/oss/src/utils/telemetry.ts`. Previously these were set to `2.1.36` and `2.1.34` respectively, while the published package was on `3.x` — every telemetry event was reporting the wrong version. The placeholder is substituted with a string literal at bundle time, so there is no extra runtime I/O and no `require("./package.json")` in the shipped bundle. ([#4897](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/pull/4897))

## Internal

- Added `mem0-ts/src/global.d.ts` declaring the `__MEM0_SDK_VERSION__` ambient constant used by the telemetry modules.
- `mem0-ts/tsup.config.ts` now reads `pkg.version` and passes `{ __MEM0_SDK_VERSION__: JSON.stringify(pkg.version) }` to `define` for both `client` and `oss` builds.
- `mem0-ts/jest.setup.ts` exposes the same value on `globalThis` so `ts-jest` test runs continue to resolve the symbol.

## Upgrade

```bash
npm install mem0ai@3.0.1
# or
pnpm add mem0ai@3.0.1
# or
yarn add mem0ai@3.0.1
```

No code changes required — this release is a drop-in replacement for `3.0.0`. After upgrading, telemetry events will report `client_version: "3.0.1"` (and future bumps to `package.json` will flow through automatically with no further source edits).

## Full Changeset

- `fix(ts-sdk): inject SDK version into telemetry at build time`
- `chore(release): bump TS SDK to 3.0.1`

**Diff:** https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0/compare/ts-v3.0.0...ts-v3.0.1

key_changes: 修复 telemetry 报告的 client_version 与实际包版本不一致的问题（从硬编码的 2.1.x 修正为 3.0.1）
通过 esbuild define 在构建时注入 SDK 版本，替换硬编码的版本字符串，无运行时 I/O 开销
MemoryClient 和 OSS Memory 两个客户端现在都报告正确的版本号
新增 mem0-ts/src/global.d.ts 声明 __MEM0_SDK_VERSION__ 全局常量

releases.summary:
## New Features
- Standalone installs are more self-contained, and `codex app` now opens or installs Desktop correctly on Windows and Intel Macs (#17022, #18500).
- The TUI can open `/side` conversations for quick side questions, and queued input now supports slash commands and `!` shell prompts while work is running (#18190, #18542).
- Plan Mode can start implementation in a fresh context, with context-usage shown before deciding whether to carry the planning thread forward (#17499, #18573).
- Plugin workflows now include tabbed browsing, inline enable/disable toggles, marketplace removal, and remote, cross-repo, or local marketplace sources (#18222, #18395, #17752, #17751, #17277, #18017, #18246).
- Filesystem permissions now support deny-read glob policies, managed deny-read requirements, platform sandbox enforcement, and isolated `codex exec` runs that ignore user config or rules (#15979, #17740, #18096, #18646).
- Tool discovery and image generation are now enabled by default, with higher-detail image handling and original-detail metadata support for MCP and `js_repl` image outputs (#17854, #17153, #17714, #18386).

## Bug Fixes
- App-server approvals, user-input prompts, and MCP elicitations now disappear from the TUI when another client resolves them, instead of leaving stale prompts behind (#15134).
- Remote-control startup now tolerates missing ChatGPT auth, and MCP startup cancellation works again through app-server sessions (#18117, #18078).
- Resumed and forked app-server threads now replay token usage immediately so context/status UI starts with the restored state (#18023).
- Security-sensitive flows were tightened: logout revokes managed ChatGPT tokens, project hooks and exec policies require trusted workspaces, and Windows sandbox setup avoids broad user-profile and SSH-root grants (#17825, #14718, #18443, #18493).
- Sandboxed `apply_patch` writes work correctly with split filesystem policies, and file watchers now notice files created after watching begins (#18296, #18492).
- Several TUI rough edges were fixed, including fatal skills-list failures, invalid resume hints, duplicate context statusline entries, `/model` menu loops, redundant memory notices, and terminal title quoting in iTerm2 (#18061, #18059, #18054, #18154, #18580, #18261).

## Documentation
- Added a security-boundaries reference to `SECURITY.md` for sandboxing, approvals, and network controls (#17848, #18004).
- Documented custom MCP server approval defaults and exec-server stdin behavior (#17843, #18086).
- Updated app-server docs for plugin API changes, marketplace removal, resume/fork token-usage replay, and warning notifications (#17277, #17751, #18023, #18298).
- Added a short guide for the responses API proxy (#18604).

## Chores
- Split plugin and marketplace code into `codex-core-plugins`, moved more connector code into `connectors`, and continued breaking up the large core session/turn modules (#18070, #18158, #18200, #18206, #18244, #18249).
- Refactored config loading and `AGENTS.md` discovery behind narrower filesystem and manager abstractions (#18209, #18035).
- Stabilized Bazel and CI with flake fixes, native Rust test sharding, scoped repository caches, stronger Windows clippy coverage, and updated `rules_rs`/LLVM pins (#17791, #18082, #18366, #18350, #18397).
- Added core CODEOWNERS and a smaller development build profile (#18362, #18612).
- Removed the stale core `models.json` and updated release preparation to refresh the active model catalog (#18585).

releases.summary:
### Minor Changes

-   `vercel env add` now defaults Environment Variables to **sensitive** on Production and Preview. Sensitive values are encrypted at rest and cannot be retrieved later via the dashboard or CLI; they are still resolved for builds, deployments, `vercel env pull`, and runtime. ([#16041](https://github.com/vercel/vercel/pull/16041))

    Behavior per target:

    -   **Production** or **Preview**: defaults to `sensitive`. Pass `--no-sensitive` to opt back in to the previous `encrypted` behavior (value remains readable later).
    -   **Development**: always stored as `encrypted` (sensitive is not supported by the Vercel API for Development). Passing `--sensitive` alongside a Development target now errors up-front instead of silently falling back.
    -   **Mixed selection** (e.g., interactive checkbox picks `production + preview + development`): errors and asks you to run `vercel env add` separately for Development, because Development cannot share a record type with Production/Preview.

    Flag summary:

    -   `--sensitive`: unchanged in meaning (request a sensitive variable); now errors when combined with Development.
    -   `--no-sensitive`: new; opt out of the new default for Production/Preview.
    -   `--sensitive --no-sensitive` together: errors.

    On teams that enable the "Enforce Sensitive Environment Variables" policy in team settings, the CLI now reads the policy from the team object and notes in the output that the policy is active; the server already promotes Production/Preview variables to sensitive silently, and the CLI's own logs are now honest about it. Passing `--no-sensitive` on a policy-on team for Production/Preview now emits a warning — the flag is a no-op because the server promotes the variable regardless — and the CLI sends `type: 'sensitive'` so its own `--debug` output matches what gets stored.

### Patch Changes

-   Updated dependencies \[[`c1866cf1add2107f91cae8292e38e4854bfe0aca`](https://github.com/vercel/vercel/commit/c1866cf1add2107f91cae8292e38e4854bfe0aca)]:

issue_insights.summary_brief: 本周期共发现5类跨仓库共性问题，影响面最广的是 Changelog/Release 生成失败（54仓）和 Trace 项目路由缺失（30仓），均为 P0；File upload 路径遍历漏洞（16仓）已出现 CVSS 9.1 级确认漏洞；包依赖强制导入问题在 11 个仓库触发 ImportError 回归。单仓高影响问题集中在 Claude Code Action 空循环/Bun 错误、Claude Code Windows 安全策略绕过、agentscope 文件操作路径遍历（CRITICAL）等 P0 缺陷。
global_highlights: File upload 路径遍历漏洞已在 agentscope 确认为 CRITICAL（CVSS 9.1），影响 16 个仓库，需优先修复并检查是否存在类似代码模式
Changelog/Release 生成跨 54 个仓库失败是影响面最大的共性问题，建议提取通用代码生成逻辑并统一处理边界条件
Claude Code Action 因 claude-sonnet-4-6 空循环和 Bun 内部错误在 GitHub-hosted runners 上完全不可用（P0）
Claude Code Windows 平台的 Write deny 规则被降级为 ask，安全策略形同虚设，建议紧急修复权限校验逻辑

top_pain_points.review_reason: This disrupts the automated release workflow, a key DevOps use case. The changelog/release generation is a critical post-development step; when it fails to complete autonomously, users must manually intervene, defeating the purpose of automation. Labeled as 'priority/medium' by triagers.

source_issues.title: Bug: Changelog and release generation
source_issues.evidence: User reports: 'When creating a release, Claude doesn't do it, it asks clarifying questions.' Steps to reproduce include generating changelog from completed tasks, but step 5 (changelog complete) never happens.

source_issues.title: Remove or standardize shim files to fix test isolation failures
source_issues.evidence: User reports: patching core.worktree.detect_git_provider has no effect because code imported via shim path ('from worktree import X') bypasses the mock. Impact: 'Tests pass/fail depending on import order across test files' and 'Module-level mocking in some tests can pollute the cache for others.' Recent fix was needed (commit f35d808c) to fix GitLab/GitHub tests.

source_issues.title: implementation_plan.json was created with an incorrect dependency reference
source_issues.evidence: User reports: 'The implementation_plan.json was created with an incorrect dependency reference (phase-4-client-lazy-loading instead of phase-5-client-lazy-loading). The implementation plan was created with the wrong dependency.' Expected: 'To not get stuck due to a dependency reference.' Log evidence: build shows 18/27 tasks done but the task chain halts.

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Dashboard overview triple-counts token usage compared to trace view and framework logs
source_issues.evidence: User reports exact 3x multiplier (8,856 vs 2,952 tokens) between dashboard overview and detailed trace view; smolagents console logs confirm the lower number; ratio is consistent across different run sizes.

source_issues.title: Integration tests flake on Windows with in-memory SQLite: `no such table: generative_model_custom_providers`
source_issues.evidence: Test fails on windows-latest + sqlite + Python 3.13 matrix cell every time with --reruns 5; log shows R R R R R E across 3 consecutive days of CI runs (Apr 14-16).

source_issues.title: `tracer.shutdown()` blocks the event loop in /chat cleanup
source_issues.evidence: tracer.shutdown() called synchronously in async generator finally block; BatchSpanProcessor.shutdown() blocks with _worker_thread.join up to 30s, freezing all concurrent async work on the worker including other chat streams, GraphQL queries, and healthchecks.

source_issues.title: gptme-eval leaks user-level prompt config into eval runs
source_issues.evidence: User with files=['~/work/my-notes.md'] gets different eval behaviour on identical benchmark runs. With path-leaking notes, model wrote hello.py to /home/bob/bob/ instead of eval workspace, causing FAIL. Fix proposed as --no-user-context flag.

source_issues.title: webui/server: multi-tool-per-message broken when break_on_tooluse=False (regression after #1724)
source_issues.evidence: Explicit warning in code at session_step.py:705-708: 'Multiple tools per message not yet supported, expect issues'. Three concrete bugs: _start_step_thread fires after each tool ignoring pending tools, call_id not propagated, undefined execution ordering. Anyone using webui with Sonnet 4.6/Opus 4.6+ hits this silently.

source_issues.title: Some commands get stuck in shell tool
source_issues.evidence: ssh localhost whoami gets stuck after output is received; gptme -n 'hello, just say hi' produces no output. Workaround requires adding -T -n flags. Related to TTY attachment. Confirmed bug with 'bug' label.

top_pain_points.topic: File upload endpoint allows arbitrary file write via path traversal (CVE-equivalent)
top_pain_points.summary: The `/resources/upload` endpoint in `superagi/controllers/resources.py` directly uses user-supplied filenames without sanitization, enabling attackers to write files outside the intended upload directory via relative path traversal (e.g., `../`) or absolute paths. Confirmed exploit shows arbitrary file write at `/tmp/superagi_traversal_1.txt` outside the designated upload directory.

top_pain_points.review_reason: Issue #1538 provides concrete exploit evidence: path traversal payload '../superagi_traversal_1.txt' was confirmed to escape the upload directory and write a file to /tmp/, proving arbitrary file write capability. This is not a hypothetical vulnerability — it is a confirmed, reproducible RCE-adjacent security flaw. The endpoint is publicly exposed (HTTP POST /api/resources/upload), allows unauthenticated file writes to arbitrary server paths, and can be chained to remote code execution by overwriting Python modules. This constitutes a critical user-impact security issue, even though it is a single issue: the impact severity (CVSS 9.1, arbitrary file write confirmed) overrides the low frequency count.

signals.topic: File upload endpoint allows arbitrary file write via path traversal (CVE-equivalent)
signals.summary: The `/resources/upload` endpoint in `superagi/controllers/resources.py` directly uses user-supplied filenames without sanitization, enabling attackers to write files outside the intended upload directory via relative path traversal (e.g., `../`) or absolute paths. Confirmed exploit shows arbitrary file write at `/tmp/superagi_traversal_1.txt` outside the designated upload directory.
aliases: Arbitrary file write via upload endpoint
signals.review_reason: Issue #1538 provides concrete exploit evidence: path traversal payload '../superagi_traversal_1.txt' was confirmed to escape the upload directory and write a file to /tmp/, proving arbitrary file write capability. This is not a hypothetical vulnerability — it is a confirmed, reproducible RCE-adjacent security flaw. The endpoint is publicly exposed (HTTP POST /api/resources/upload), allows unauthenticated file writes to arbitrary server paths, and can be chained to remote code execution by overwriting Python modules. This constitutes a critical user-impact security issue, even though it is a single issue: the impact severity (CVSS 9.1, arbitrary file write confirmed) overrides the low frequency count.

source_issues.title: File Upload Path Traversal Vulnerability in /resources/upload Endpoint Allows Arbitrary File Write
source_issues.evidence: Confirmed exploit: payload '../superagi_traversal_1.txt' successfully escaped upload directory and wrote file to /tmp/superagi_traversal_1.txt. HTTP 201 response returned. Attack can overwrite Python modules, config files, or write to web-accessible directories. CVSS 9.1 (Critical).

signals.topic: DeepResearchAgent crashes with KeyError and AttributeError during execution due to unexpected model response structure
signals.summary: DeepResearchAgent crashes when models return response blocks in unexpected structures — either a thinking block before the text block causing KeyError on `blocks[0]['text']`, or None metadata causing AttributeError on `chunk.metadata.get()`. The agent's hard-coded assumptions about block order and metadata presence break with models like Qwen3.5-397B.
aliases: DeepResearchAgent crashes on model response format variation
signals.review_reason: DeepResearchAgent crashes (count=2) block the primary research workflow entirely. Both crashes are confirmed with full stack traces and reproducible steps — one from unexpected thinking block ordering (KeyError), another from None metadata access (AttributeError). These represent a pattern where the agent cannot handle model response format variation, causing complete workflow failure for affected users.

source_issues.title: [Bug]:DeepResearchAgent raises KeyError with Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FPB due to thinking block in response blocks
source_issues.evidence: Confirmed KeyError crash at line 931 `blocks[0]['text']`. Model returns `[{'type': 'thinking', 'thinking': '...'}, {'type': 'text', 'text': '...'}]` — thinking block first, no 'text' key. Agent fails to produce final report, returns error output `Error: 'text'`. Reproducible on Windows with Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FPB.

source_issues.title: [Bug]:AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get' in DeepResearchAgent._acting
source_issues.evidence: Confirmed AttributeError crash at `chunk.metadata.get('success')` where `chunk.metadata` is None. Full traceback provided. Reproducible on Windows with DeepResearchAgent's `_acting` method. Agent terminates abnormally without completing the research task.

signals.topic: File path traversal vulnerability in text file operations allows arbitrary file writes on the host system
signals.summary: The `insert_text_file` and `write_text_file` functions in the file service module accept arbitrary paths including path traversal sequences (`../`) and absolute paths without any validation, allowing a malicious or compromised LLM to write files anywhere the process has write access. This is a CRITICAL (CVSS 9.1) vulnerability confirmed with real LLM (MiniMax API) execution via a ReActAgent.
aliases: path traversal in file write operations
arbitrary file write vulnerability in text.py
signals.review_reason: CRITICAL security vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) with confirmed exploitation in real LLM execution. A ReActAgent autonomously generated and executed a path traversal attack via the `insert_text_file` and `write_text_file` tools. Allows arbitrary file writes on the host system — equivalent to RCE. This is a primary-flow security flaw in core file tool functions used by all agents.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Two Path Traversal in File Operations
source_issues.evidence: CRITICAL CVSS 9.1. Two functions (`insert_text_file`, `write_text_file`) confirmed exploited with real MiniMax API ReActAgent execution. Attacker can write arbitrary files anywhere on the host by injecting `../` sequences. No path validation whatsoever before file open. All OS platforms affected.

signals.topic: AgentScope Studio fails to track model calls and token consumption when ReActAgent is called directly without memory wrapper
signals.summary: AgentScope Studio's monitoring (model call counts, token usage tracking) does not record metrics when ReActAgent is used directly. Metrics are only tracked when a Mem0LongTermMemory retrieval call precedes the ReActAgent invocation. This means the primary monitoring dashboard gives incomplete usage data for the most common agent usage pattern.
aliases: AgentScope Studio not counting ReActAgent metrics
token consumption tracking missing for direct ReActAgent calls
studio monitoring blind spot when ReActAgent used standalone
signals.review_reason: AgentScope Studio monitoring is a key user-facing feature for tracking LLM usage and costs. When ReActAgent is called directly (the primary usage pattern), Studio fails to record any model calls or token consumption, creating a complete observability gap. Users relying on Studio for cost tracking or usage analysis get zero data for their main workflow. Though count=1, the evidence shows a consistent, reproducible blind spot in critical monitoring infrastructure.

source_issues.title: [Bug]:When ReActAgent is called, AgentScope Studio cannot count information such as model calls and Token consumption
source_issues.evidence: User reports that when ReActAgent is called directly, AgentScope Studio shows zero model calls and zero token consumption. When Mem0LongTermMemory is called first, metrics appear correctly. This is a consistent blind spot in the monitoring system for the most typical ReActAgent usage pattern (direct invocation without memory wrapper).

signals.topic: Memory compression with AsyncSQLAlchemyMemory causes foreign key constraint violation breaking the agent
signals.summary: When using AsyncSQLAlchemyMemory with memory compression enabled, the agent crashes with a SQLAlchemy IntegrityError: foreign key constraint violation. The root cause is that `bulk_insert_mappings` for `message_mark` records is called before the pending `message` records are flushed to the database, resulting in a missing foreign key reference.
aliases: message_mark foreign key violation during memory compression
SQLAlchemy bulk_insert_mappings foreign key constraint with compression
signals.review_reason: Memory compression is a user-intended feature for handling long conversations, but when enabled with AsyncSQLAlchemyMemory it causes a hard crash with a database integrity error, completely breaking the agent workflow. The evidence includes a full stack trace and a complete reproduction recipe. This is a functional block: users who want both compression and async SQL storage cannot use them together, forcing a workaround or disabling a needed feature.

source_issues.title: [Bug]:Short-term memory使用AsyncSQLAlchemyMemory式，如果开启Memory Compression时，运行报错
source_issues.evidence: Full SQLAlchemy traceback showing `IntegrityError: ForeignKeyViolationError` on `message_mark` table referencing non-existent `msg_id`. The error occurs specifically during memory compression when `bulk_insert_mappings` is called before `session.flush()`. User provided complete reproduction steps and stack trace. Confirmed on AgentScope 1.0.18 with PostgreSQL/asyncpg.

signals.topic: GLM-5 model with compression enabled causes ValueError in model response parsing, breaking ReActAgent
signals.summary: When using GLM-5 model with memory compression enabled in ReActAgent, the model returns response content that causes a JSON parsing ValueError ('expected value at line 1 column 1'), triggering a RuntimeError in the fallback chain and breaking the agent. The error is reproducible even when the model's thinking mode is explicitly disabled.
aliases: GLM-5 compression ValueError expected value at line 1 column 1
ReActAgent compression fails with GLM-5 model
glm-5 thinking stream breaks compression pipeline
signals.review_reason: ReActAgent with GLM-5 model and compression enabled produces a ValueError that propagates through the entire fallback chain, causing the agent to fail. This is a primary-flow block: users combining a popular model (GLM-5) with a commonly used feature (memory compression) experience complete workflow failure with a non-obvious error message. The issue is reproducible and well-documented with full stack trace.

source_issues.title: [Bug]:glm-5 model enable CompressionConfig Compression failed
source_issues.evidence: Confirmed RuntimeError wrapping ValueError 'expected value at line 1 column 1' in the model response stream. Traceback shows the error originates in the compression pipeline at `_compress_memory_if_needed`. All models in fallback chain fail. Reproducible on AgentScope 1.0.16 with GLM-5 model (thinking explicitly disabled). Affects the primary ReActAgent execution path.

signals.topic: litellm/aws extras 导入时因 anthropic 包强制依赖而崩溃

signals.review_reason: 回归问题（v2.5.14 引入）：litellm 和 aws 额外包用户在无 anthropic 包时遭遇立即的运行时崩溃，直接阻断主流程，影响所有仅安装这两个额外包之一而不安装 anthropic 的用户。有明确的复现步骤和根本原因分析（agno/utils/models/claude.py 顶层无条件导入），非边缘场景。

source_issues.title: [Bug] agno.models.litellm and agno.models.aws.bedrock require anthropic to be installed

signals.topic: Milvus 向量数据库与 contents_db 联合使用时知识摄入完全失败
signals.summary: Milvus 与 PostgresDb contents_db 联合使用时存在多个致命错误：(1) text 字段默认最大长度仅 1000 字符，导致 upsert 时 MilvusException: length exceeds max length；(2) metadata/filters 传入了 Python dict 而非 JSON 字符串，导致 DataNotMatchException；(3) 旧版 Milvus 不支持 partial upsert。这些错误导致 RAG 知识摄入完全失败，用户无法使用 Milvus 作为向量数据库进行知识管理。
signals.review_reason: 明确的运行时错误：Milvus+RAG 知识摄入全流程阻断。用户提供了完整复现代码和两条独立错误堆栈（MilvusException + DataNotMatchException），均属于用户可感知的真实使用场景（知识管理）。非边缘场景，影响所有尝试将 Milvus 与 contents_db 联合使用的用户。

source_issues.title: [Bug] milvus with contents_db error
source_issues.evidence: MilvusException: length exceeds max length (row number: 0, length: 6750, max length: 1000) when upserting documents with Milvus+contents_db. DataNotMatchException: meta_data field should be a varchar, but got a {<class 'dict'>} — metadata needs JSON serialization. 用户提供完整堆栈和复现代码，Milvus collection 无法成功摄入任何实质性文档。

signals.topic: AGUI 接口使用 Teams+ReasoningTools 时 Pydantic 验证崩溃
signals.summary: 通过 AGUI 接口发送请求时，当 Team 使用 ReasoningTools，yield ReasoningMessageStartEvent 会触发 Pydantic 验证错误：role 字段硬编码为 'reasoning' 但 ReasoningMessageStartEvent 的 Pydantic 模型要求 role='assistant'，导致运行时 ValidationError 并伴随完整堆栈，AgentOS 服务直接崩溃并返回 ERROR，日志中显示错误无法恢复。用户无法通过 AGUI 使用带有推理工具的 Team，功能完全不可用。
signals.review_reason: 关键接口崩溃：AGUI 是 Agno 的核心 Web 接口，Pydantic 验证错误在事件流中触发，导致整个 AgentOS 服务报错，用户请求完全失败。这不是警告或性能问题，而是用户通过 AGUI 使用 Teams with ReasoningTools 时直接崩溃。有完整堆栈和具体触发条件，置信度高。

source_issues.title: [Bug] Send request by AGUI, an exception occurs due to Pydantic validation failure when yield ReasoningMessageStartEvent
source_issues.evidence: pydantic_core.ValidationError: 1 validation error for ReasoningMessageStartEvent role Input should be 'assistant'. Full stack trace shows crash at agni/os/interfaces/agui/utils.py:383 in _create_events_from_chunk. 'Error running team' logged. Crashes when Team uses ReasoningTools and receives AGUI request.

signals.topic: MCP init 时 header merge 因 headers=None 导致 TypeError 崩溃
signals.summary: MCPTools 和 MultiMCPTools 在初始化时调用 header_provider 以支持认证 MCP 服务器的工具发现，但 merge 逻辑假设 server_params.headers 始终是 dict。对于 SSEClientParams 和 StreamableHTTPClientParams，headers 默认值为 None，当 header_provider 返回非空 dict 时，初始化在首次网络请求之前就崩溃，TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not a mapping。这导致带有自定义 header_provider 的 MCP 服务器初始化完全失败，工具发现被阻断。
signals.review_reason: MCP 初始化阶段的类型错误导致完全崩溃：这是 init-time 错误，在任何工具发现或网络请求之前就发生，完全阻断 MCP 工具集成。有明确的复现步骤（设置 header_provider + 默认 HTTP params），影响所有在 MCP 服务器参数中使用 header_provider 的用户，包括 SSE 和 streamable-http 两种传输方式。

source_issues.title: [Bug] MCP init-time header merge crashes when server_params.headers is None
source_issues.evidence: TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not a mapping at init time for MCPTools and MultiMCPTools when header_provider returns non-empty dict but headers defaults to None. Crash occurs before first network call. Affects both SSE and streamable-http transports. Logs show: 'TypeError \'NoneType\' object is not a mapping'.

signals.topic: pgvector/Milvus embedder 过载时静默创建 NULL 向量条目导致数据损坏
signals.summary: 当 embedder 端点过载返回 429 错误且 httpx 达到 max_retries 上限时，RAG 表中被创建了 NULL 向量条目而非抛出异常。这些 NULL 条目静默存在于数据库中，导致后续搜索返回错误结果或空结果，用户在不知情的情况下使用损坏的向量数据进行检索。预期行为应该是完全不插入条目，而不是创建 NULL 行。
signals.review_reason: 静默数据损坏：NULL 向量条目被静默写入数据库而非抛出异常，后续向量搜索会返回错误结果。这是典型的静默失败模式，用户可能在不知情的情况下依赖错误的检索结果。虽然仅 1 条报告，但数据完整性是用户可感知的严重问题，应纳入 P2。

source_issues.title: [Bug] NULL Pgvector embeddings
source_issues.evidence: 当 embedder 返回 429 并耗尽 httpx 重试次数时，RAG 表中出现 NULL 向量行。预期：不应插入任何条目；实际：创建了带 NULL 向量的损坏条目。日志显示 'RPC error: upsert_rows' 后数据已入库。

source_issues.evidence: Both npm and curl install succeed (1.14.19 confirmed installed), but CLI immediately rejects launch with version detection error on WSL2/GNU/Linux x86_64. User is completely blocked from using opencode after install.

signals.topic: System theme no longer shows through terminal colors, breaking user-customized terminal color schemes

terminal color scheme not respected by System theme

source_issues.evidence: User with detailed wezterm color scheme (trad colors) reports black background instead of expected terminal colors after upgrading to v1.14.19. Regression from prior behavior where System theme showed through terminal colors. Screenshot evidence attached.

signals.topic: Sessions from other git worktrees of the same project hidden after upgrade, blocking multi-worktree workflows
signals.summary: After upgrading to v1.14.19 from v1.2.25, sessions from other git worktrees of the same repository are invisible. Only sessions created in the current worktree directory are shown, hiding 53+ existing sessions from the same project. signals.review_reason: Confirmed regression with explicit database evidence: 53+ prior sessions hidden after upgrade, blocking multi-worktree workflow. Clear before/after behavior documented with screenshots.

signals.topic: ToParam() omitzero pattern silently drops zero-value fields in server tool result blocks, causing API 400 errors in multi-turn agentic loops
signals.summary: Multiple tool result block types (CodeExecution, WebSearch, ToolSearch) have ToParam() methods that use omitzero JSON tags. When these tools return zero/empty values (e.g., return_code=0, empty stderr/stdout — extremely common for successful executions), the fields are silently dropped during re-serialization. The malformed request then triggers 400 errors from the API, blocking the agentic loop from continuing. The bug is systematic and reliably reproducible in production with extended thinking and server tools.
aliases: server tool result block omitzero bug
signals.review_reason: This is a production-impacting bug with clear user impact: it causes API 400 errors that block multi-turn agentic loops from continuing. The root cause (omitzero dropping zero-value fields in ToParam()) is systematically present across at least 3 tool result block types, making it a widespread pattern issue. The issue includes a reliable reproduction path and a workaround, confirming real-world impact. Count=1 reflects this single file; the issue itself documents the same-class pattern (refs #317, #242). Confidence reduced slightly because this file only contains one of three related issues, though the systematic pattern is acknowledged by the reporter.

source_issues.title: CodeExecutionToolResultBlock.ToParam() drops stdout/stderr/return_code via omitzero (same class as #242, #317)
source_issues.evidence: Multi-turn agentic loop with code execution reliably fails with 400 API error: 'RequestCodeExecutionToolResultError.type: Input should be code_execution_tool_result_error'. Root cause: omitzero drops return_code=0, empty stderr, empty stdout. Same class of bug as #317 (ToolSearchToolResultBlock) and #242 (WebSearchToolResultBlock). Reproducible in production with claude-opus-4-7, extended thinking, and 20+ tool calls.

signals.topic: Official documentation examples use Go types that do not exist in the SDK library, preventing users from compiling the documented code
signals.summary: The official Anthropic documentation (platform.claude.com) provides Go code examples for the Managed Agents API that reference types which do not exist in the published SDK (v1.35.1): BetaSessionEventSendParams, BetaManagedAgentsUserDefineOutcomeEventParams, BetaManagedAgentsUserDefineOutcomeEventParamsRubricUnion, BetaManagedAgentsTextRubricParams, and SendEventsParamsUnion. Users attempting to use these examples get compile errors and cannot proceed, blocking adoption of the Managed Agents feature.
aliases: docs example types missing from SDK
Managed Agents Go example types don't exist
signals.review_reason: This is a clear developer experience and documentation accuracy issue. Users attempting to follow the official documentation cannot compile the provided Go examples, which directly blocks adoption of the Managed Agents feature. While count=1 (single issue), the root cause (documentation-library mismatch) likely affects any user who reads the docs and tries to use the Go SDK. The issue provides specific missing type names and the exact documentation URL, making this well-evidenced.

source_issues.title: Examples in documentation use types that don't exist.
source_issues.evidence: User attempted to compile the official Go example from platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/define-outcomes and received compile errors. Types referenced in docs (BetaSessionEventSendParams, BetaManagedAgentsUserDefineOutcomeEventParams, etc.) do not exist in v1.35.1. User explicitly asks whether these are preview/undocumented features or if there is a separate SDK with these types.

signals.topic: Java SDK structured output schema generator ignores nullability markers, forcing all fields into required array
signals.summary: When using outputConfig(Class) for structured JSON output, the Java SDK's schema generator marks all Java class/record fields as required regardless of @Nullable annotations or Optional<T> types. This causes LLMs to hallucinate values (e.g. string 'null', empty strings) to satisfy schema constraints, breaking the structured output feature for nullable fields.
aliases: Kotlin KType nullability not respected for Java classes
signals.review_reason: This is a genuine user pain point: the structured output feature, which is a core SDK capability, produces incorrect JSON schemas for Java classes with optional fields. The impact is real — LLM responses contain hallucinated placeholder values instead of null/empty, breaking the primary use case of structured output for nullable data. User confirmed no workaround exists. However, count=1 from a single repo, so P2 is appropriate.

source_issues.title: [Java SDK] Structured Output: Java fields are always included in the required array, ignoring nullability markers
source_issues.evidence: User reports that @jakarta.annotation.Nullable, @javax.annotation.Nullable, @JsonProperty(required=false), and java.util.Optional are all silently ignored by the schema generator. The LLM (Claude 3.5/4.5) is forced to hallucinate values to satisfy required constraints, even when system prompt instructs it to leave fields empty. The workaround of submitting a PR was proposed by the user themselves, indicating no SDK-provided workaround exists.

signals.topic: Managed Agents MCP client 不支持 Streamable HTTP transport，导致 Apify 等主流 MCP 服务器完全不可用
signals.summary: CMA MCP client 仅支持 SSE transport，不支持 Streamable HTTP（当前 MCP 官方推荐的 transport），导致仅支持 Streamable HTTP 的 MCP 服务器（如 Apify）在初始化阶段即失败，agent 无法使用任何工具。
aliases: Streamable HTTP not supported in Managed Agents
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：Managed Agents 是 SDK 的核心功能，MCP 工具不可用直接导致 agent 无法使用外部工具完成关键任务。Apify 是生产级 MCP 服务商，官方已强制迁移至 Streamable HTTP，用户无任何客户端侧 workaround，属于关键功能不可用而非边缘场景。

source_issues.title: Managed Agents MCP client only supports SSE transport — incompatible with servers that have dropped SSE (e.g. Apify)
source_issues.evidence: Apify 于 2026-04-01 弃用 SSE endpoint，现仅支持 Streamable HTTP。使用 CMA 配置 Apify MCP server 时，初始化直接失败并报错 'SSE data line is not valid JSON'。Workaround: None — 用户完全无法使用 Apify。Claude Code 本身已支持 Streamable HTTP MCP，但 Managed Agents session 层未接入。

signals.topic: CMA MCP 客户端在 Streamable HTTP 回退模式下工具调用结果被静默丢弃，agent 误报工具失败

aliases: MCP tool results silently lost after 406 fallback
CMA tool call result relay failure
signals.review_reason: 数据丢失 + 误导性错误信息：工具调用结果在 SDK relay 层被静默丢弃，agent 获得错误结论（工具失败）而非正确结果，属于严重的主流程数据丢失场景。用户无法从错误信息判断是 SDK bug 而非 server 故障，有明确 server logs 证据证明数据已返回但未到达 agent。

source_issues.title: CMA: Tool call results silently lost when server returns 406 on GET /mcp SSE probe

signals.topic: Beta 流式消息累加器 ParsedBetaContentBlock union 缺少 BetaToolSearchToolResultBlock 和 BetaWebFetchToolResultBlock，导致 get_final_message() 静默丢失 block

signals.topic: API-key users silently billed at 5-minute cache TTL instead of 1-hour due to outdated bundled CLI
signals.summary: SDK v0.1.59 bundles CLI 2.1.105 which predates `ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H`. The env var is silently dropped, causing all cache writes to be billed at the 5-minute tier indefinitely. User reports hundreds of thousands of agent turns affected over 8 months with compounding cost on long sessions (16–60 min). Anthropic's developer relations had publicly stated SDK customers get automatic prompt caching savings, which does not hold for API-key users.
aliases: prompt caching savings not reaching SDK users
signals.review_reason: This is a user pain point with clear financial impact: API-key SDK users have been silently overcharged for 8 months of production use because the bundled CLI version predates the feature that enables 1-hour cache TTL. The advertised 'automatic savings' from Anthropic developer relations do not apply. There is no error message — the env var is silently dropped, making this a hidden cost leak that compounds on the SDK's primary workload (long multi-minute agent sessions). This qualifies as 'obvious cost loss' under pain point criteria.

source_issues.title: API-key users silently stuck on 5m cache TTL: bundled CLI in v0.1.59 predates ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H opt-in
source_issues.evidence: Reproduction data: SDK with ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H=1 shows ttl=5m 1h=0 5m=4139 (no effect). System CLI 2.1.110 with same env var shows ttl=1h 1h=59214 5m=0. User reports hundreds of thousands of agent turns over 8 months of production usage all billed at 5-minute tier. No warning, no error, just silent financial loss.

signals.topic: ClaudeAgentOptions.effort type definition missing 'xhigh' and CLI rejection surfaced as opaque ProcessError
signals.summary: The Python type for `ClaudeAgentOptions.effort` is `Literal['low', 'medium', 'high', 'max']` but the bundled Claude Code CLI also supports 'xhigh'. When users pass an unsupported effort value, the SDK raises a generic `ProcessError` with no stderr details, making diagnosis impossible. TypeScript users are also misled about valid options.
aliases: ProcessError with no stderr on invalid effort
xhigh effort value missing from SDK types
signals.review_reason: This is a user pain point: outdated type definitions actively mislead users about available options (xhigh is missing), and opaque error messages make debugging impossible when an unsupported value is used. The combination of bad types + silent failure creates a confusing experience where users cannot discover valid values through IDE tooling and cannot diagnose failures when they try unsupported ones.

source_issues.title: ClaudeAgentOptions.effort typings are outdated, and CLI validation failures are surfaced as opaque ProcessError
source_issues.evidence: Type definition only includes 'low, medium, high, max' but CLI also supports 'xhigh'. When SDK forwards an unsupported value to CLI, exception text is just 'Command failed with exit code 1. Error output: Check stderr output for details' with no actual stderr content included.

signals.topic: PostToolUse hook updatedMCPToolOutput causes renderer crash 'H.reduce is not a function'
signals.summary: When a PostToolUse hook returns a valid updatedMCPToolOutput, the JavaScript renderer crashes with 'H.reduce is not a function'. Python-side hook executes correctly and returns properly shaped content, but the renderer cannot process the output, causing all MCP tool results to show as failed. Additionally, SDK documentation and runtime have inconsistent tool_response shapes.
aliases: H.reduce is not a function PostToolUse
MCP tool output crash in renderer
signals.review_reason: This is a user pain point: the PostToolUse hook mechanism, when used as documented, causes a complete renderer crash that makes all MCP tool results appear as failed. This is a main flow break for any user using PostToolUse hooks with MCP tools. The Python side works correctly (verified by user logs), but the JS renderer cannot process the output, indicating an SDK-level serialization issue. The additional docs/runtime inconsistency on tool_response shape compounds the problem.

source_issues.title: PostToolUse hook updatedMCPToolOutput causes H.reduce is not a function in renderer despite correct hook output
source_issues.evidence: Python hook logs confirm correct execution with valid content arrays. Renderer crashes with 'H.reduce is not a function' across all tools on the MCP server simultaneously. All three tools reported as failed in the UI. SDK docs state tool_response is a dict with content key, but runtime delivers a bare list — a documented vs. runtime inconsistency requiring defensive isinstance checks.

signals.topic: Opus 4.7 API rejects thinking.type.enabled and requires thinking.type.adaptive + output_config.effort
signals.summary: On Opus 4.7, sending `thinking.type.enabled` in API requests causes a 400 invalid_request_error. The SDK defaults to this value on Opus 4.7, resulting in API errors for users who use the default thinking configuration on that model. Even switching to ThinkingConfigAdaptive does not resolve it when using the bundled CLI.
aliases: Opus 4.7 API error on thinking config
signals.review_reason: This is a user pain point: default SDK configuration causes API errors on Opus 4.7, blocking the main query flow for affected users. The error message is cryptic (a raw API 400 with no SDK-level guidance). However, count=1 and the issue was closed, suggesting it may have been addressed in a subsequent version. Kept as P2 due to single-source evidence.

source_issues.title: Opus 4.7 + 0.1.58 = thinking.type.enabled errors?
source_issues.evidence: API returns 400: 'thinking.type.enabled is not supported for this model. Use thinking.type.adaptive and output_config.effort'. Error reproduced with bundled CLI 2.1.111 and system CLI. Indicates SDK default thinking config is incompatible with Opus 4.7.

signals.topic: skillOverrides 'off' 设置未生效：已禁用的技能仍出现在模型技能列表中，导致模型困惑
signals.summary: 设置 skillOverrides: { "<name>": "off" } 后，SDK 正确拦截技能调用，但模型系统提示词中仍列出该技能。用户看到的现象是模型声称某技能可用，但尝试调用时被拒绝，体验断裂。
aliases: skillOverrides off not hiding skills from listing
disabled skills still visible in model prompt
signals.review_reason: 明确bug：文档与实现不一致，用户观察到行为与预期不符，模型层体验断裂（声称有某技能但调用被拒）。count=1单仓问题，降级为P1。

source_issues.title: skillOverrides "off" blocks invocation but doesn't hide skills from the model's skill listing
source_issues.evidence: 设置10个内置技能为off后，模型仍列出全部技能并在尝试调用时报Skill <name> is disabled。文档承诺off同时隐藏技能，但实际仅实现调用拦截，listing pass未读取skillOverrides。

signals.topic: query({resume}) 会话恢复时静默丢弃 tool_use/tool_result 序列，导致代理重复执行副作用操作
signals.summary: 大型会话 JSONL 在 resume 时，SDK 重建对话历史过程中静默丢弃早期 turns 的 tool_use/tool_result 配对，仅保留 user/assistant 文本。后果是代理无法感知自身已执行过的副作用操作（数据库写入、外部API调用等），在不同容器启动间重复执行，产生重复记录。
aliases: duplicate side-effecting actions on cold resume
signals.review_reason: 高严重度主流程阻断：多轮会话工具副作用（数据库写入、外部API写入、无幂等键操作）会因resume而重复执行，在生产环境中造成数据重复/损坏。用户已实际观测到多种重复记录，是真实发生的生产事故而非理论推断。

source_issues.title: query({resume}) silently drops tool_use/tool_result sequences from earlier turns when session JSONL grows large
source_issues.evidence: 1.8MB会话JSONL中，工具序列在resume重建时被丢弃；同一会话中观察到重复的notebook source、cloud-storage folder、file upload；代理有用户消息和自身文本回复但无对应tool_use记录。重建filters或token预算截断为根因。

signals.topic: SDK 写入的 assistant 条目 parentUuid 引用不存在的 UUID，导致会话 resume 时上下文完全丢失
signals.summary: SDK 向 session JSONL 写入 assistant 条目时，其 parentUuid 引用了一个从未作为任何 entry.uuid 出现过的 UUID（幽灵父节点）。resume 时 parent-chain walker 在第一个幽灵父节点处停止，导致模型切换后整个会话历史消失，用户消息全部不可见。
aliases: orphan parentUuid causes session collapse on resume
parent chain broken after model switch
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：模型切换→容器重启→resume 场景下会话上下文完全丢失，用户消息不可见，代理完全丧失多轮上下文。生产环境常见触发路径，用户已实际遭遇并自写 workaround。

source_issues.title: SDK writes assistant entries with parentUuid referencing UUIDs not present in the transcript file
source_issues.evidence: 重现会话中5个UUID均只作为parentUuid出现、从未作为uuid出现；模型切换触发容器重启后resume仅返回最后一个assistant turn，全部用户消息丢失；用户被迫自写transcript sanitizer作为workaround。

signals.topic: CLI stdin 写入时未等待 initialize ack，导致 prompt cache 效率下降至约82%
signals.summary: SDK 在 CLI 的 initialize 控制消息尚未被确认前就写入用户消息到 stdin，导致 CLI 初始化 MCP 服务器映射尚未完成时即处理用户消息，使得第一轮和第二轮的 tools 列表不一致，破坏了 Anthropic prompt cache 的连续性。本应接近100%的 cache read 率下降至约82%。
aliases: initialize race causes cache efficiency drop
Rv stdin write before init ack
prompt cache broken by MCP tool ordering
signals.review_reason: 可量化的成本损失：prompt cache 效率从接近100%降至82%，直接影响 token 成本和响应延迟。race condition 已被复现（9/13次），单行修复有效，但根因为未 await 初始化 promise，证据充分。count=1单仓问题，标记为P1。

source_issues.title: Rv writes user message without awaiting A.initialization, causing stdin race at CLI
source_issues.evidence: cache_read_input_tokens 本应接近100%（每次boot仅14k基线），实测降至82%；A.initialization promise 存在但未被 await；单行修复（await A.initialization）通过9/13测试，CLI侧gate方案10/10。

signals.topic: claude-sonnet-4-6 returns repeated empty turns causing silent-success with no artifacts produced
signals.summary: When using claude-sonnet-4-6, the action enters a tight loop of empty turns (stop_reason: null, output_tokens: 8), retries for ~20 minutes, then exits as 'success' with zero artifacts — no commits, no branch, no result. Downstream steps cannot distinguish this from a normal completion.
signals.review_reason: Main workflow is blocked — the action silently succeeds with no artifacts after consuming ~20 minutes of API quota and rate limits. The workflow cannot distinguish this failure mode from normal completion. This is a primary workflow failure with direct cost impact (burns Max weekly budget).

source_issues.title: claude-sonnet-4-6 silent-fails with repeated empty turns (stop_reason: null, output_tokens: 8) — reproduces on v1.0.100 and v1.0.101
source_issues.evidence: Reproduces on v1.0.100 and v1.0.101. 3 independent runs with identical signature. Sonnet-specific, not prompt or scaffold issue. Control run with Opus-4.7 on same prompt completes successfully. Action exits 'success' but produces zero artifacts, consuming ~20 min of API quota with no value. User reports burning Max weekly budget on runs that produce nothing.

signals.topic: Bun internal error 'directory mismatch' on every invocation in v1 action on GitHub-hosted runners
signals.summary: Every invocation of v1 action on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest runners fails with a Bun internal error: 'directory mismatch for directory .../tsconfig.json'. No user code runs. This completely blocks the action on standard GitHub-hosted runners.
signals.review_reason: The action fails on every invocation for standard GitHub-hosted runners — a critical regression that renders the action unusable on the primary target platform. This is a primary workflow blocker with 100% failure rate on affected environments.

source_issues.title: Bun: Internal error 'directory mismatch for directory' in v1 action on GitHub-hosted runners
source_issues.evidence: Reproduces on every PR in the reporter's repo on ubuntu-latest GitHub-hosted runners. Error occurs during action setup, before any user inputs are consumed. Blocks green CI for any repo requiring all checks to pass.

signals.topic: v1.0.100 breaks self-hosted runners behind corporate firewall — install.sh silently fails, bundled binary fallback broken
signals.summary: v1.0.100 regressed self-hosted runners where claude.ai is unreachable. install.sh curl silently fails (bash pipe exits 0), then the SDK throws 'native binary not found' because pathToClaudeCodeExecutable is set to non-existent path instead of undefined, bypassing the bundled npm binary fallback that worked in v1.0.99.
signals.review_reason: This is a confirmed regression in v1.0.100 that breaks the action for self-hosted runners in restricted network environments. The install.sh silent failure combined with the SDK bundled binary bypass creates a complete failure mode that worked in v1.0.99. The silent failure of the install step (no pipefail) is also a UX defect.

source_issues.title: v1.0.100 breaks environments where claude.ai is unreachable (install.sh silently fails, SDK bundled binary bypassed)
source_issues.evidence: Regression introduced in v1.0.100 PR #1235. Reproduces on every PR in the reporter's environment. install.sh curl SSL error masked by bash exiting 0 in pipe. pathToClaudeCodeExecutable set to non-existent path, bypassing bundled binary that worked in v1.0.99. Users behind corporate firewalls cannot use the action without downgrading.

signals.topic: Fork PRs fail — action fetches branch by name instead of refs/pull/N/head
signals.summary: When @claude is tagged on a fork PR, the action fails with 'could not find remote ref <branch-name>' because it fetches by branch name rather than using GitHub's refs/pull/N/head mechanism. Additionally, the action does not update its comment to indicate failure.
aliases: external fork PR cannot be reviewed
signals.review_reason: The action cannot handle fork PRs — a common real-world workflow. The crash is complete (action fails), and the stale comment state misleads users about the actual outcome. This blocks a legitimate and common use case.

source_issues.title: Fork PRs fail: action fetches branch by name instead of using refs/pull/N/head
source_issues.evidence: Root cause identified in source code: setupBranch runs 'git fetch origin <branch-name>' but fork branches only exist on the fork's remote, not on origin. GitHub exposes fork PR content at refs/pull/<number>/head but action does not use this ref. Workarounds (pre-fetching branch) also fail because action explicitly re-fetches by name. Comment remains in 'working' state on failure.

signals.topic: execution_file output not written when SDK throws on error_max_turns — blocks downstream integrations
signals.summary: When the SDK throws (e.g., error_max_turns), the execution_file is never written to disk because the writeFile call occurs after the try/catch block that re-throws. Downstream steps relying on execution_file for cost/turn/duration data receive no data.
aliases: execution file not written on error
partial execution data lost on failure
signals.review_reason: Key diagnostic data is silently lost on a failure that may not be the user's fault (model hitting max turns). Downstream integrations that depend on execution_file for metrics or post-run analysis are broken. This is a functional regression in the action's output contract.

source_issues.title: execution_file output not written when SDK throws on error_max_turns
source_issues.evidence: Root cause traced to source code in base-action/src/run-claude-sdk.ts: writeFile is after the try/catch block that re-throws, so it's never reached. The messages array is populated before the throw, so partial data is available but lost. Downstream steps expecting structured cost/turn/duration data from execution_file get nothing.

signals.topic: Agent tool does not inherit deferred tools from parent agent
signals.summary: Agents spawned via the Agent tool don't inherit deferred tools like WebSearch, causing silent failures when delegating web search tasks.
signals.review_reason: Significant experience degradation: Agents spawned via the Agent tool cannot use deferred tools like WebSearch, causing silent failures when delegating web search tasks. This defeats the purpose of using agents for complex workflows.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Agent tool doesn't inherit deferred tools from parent agent
source_issues.evidence: Agents spawned via the Agent tool don't have access to deferred tools like WebSearch. Delegating web search tasks to agents silently fails.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Agent tool doesn't inherit deferred tools from parent agent
source_issues.evidence: Same issue as 51317 - agents don't inherit deferred tools from parent.

signals.topic: Slack MCP OAuth callback port 3118 conflict blocks parallel sessions
signals.summary: Only one Claude Code session can complete Slack OAuth at a time due to hardcoded port 3118, causing unrecoverable auth failures for users with parallel sessions.
signals.review_reason: Main flow blocking: Users cannot authenticate to Slack MCP when running multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel. This is a hard auth failure with no workaround except killing other sessions.

source_issues.title: [Slack MCP] Hardcoded OAuth callback port 3118 prevents authentication when multiple Claude Code sessions run in parallel
source_issues.evidence: Only one Claude Code session can complete Slack OAuth at a time due to hardcoded port 3118. Users with parallel sessions get unrecoverable auth failures.

signals.topic: Session history not displayed in Claude for Windows 1.3561.0 regression
signals.summary: Sessions exist on disk but are not surfaced in the UI on Windows after updating to 1.3561.0. Users cannot resume prior projects.
signals.review_reason: Main flow blocking: Users cannot access previous sessions on Windows after updating to 1.3561.0. This is a critical regression that breaks the primary workflow of resuming prior projects.

source_issues.title: Claude for Windows 1.3561.0: session history no longer displayed
source_issues.evidence: Sessions exist on disk but are not surfaced in the UI. Users cannot open a project folder or resume a previous project session from within the app.

signals.topic: Write deny rules behave as ask on Windows — security policy bypass
signals.summary: On Windows, Write entries in the deny list are not enforced as denials. Instead of blocking, permission prompts are shown allowing writes that should be blocked.
aliases: deny rules show as ask on Windows
signals.review_reason: Security policy bypass: Deny rules intended to block file writes are circumvented by permission prompts, allowing writes that should be blocked. This undermines organization-managed security settings and creates confidentiality risks.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Write deny rules behave as ask — file creation is prompted instead of automatically blocked; also affects organization-managed settings
source_issues.evidence: On Windows, Write entries in the deny list are not enforced as denials. Instead of blocking, Claude Code shows a permission prompt where users can approve writes, defeating deny rules entirely.

signals.topic: Trust prompt re-appears every session for home directory on Windows
signals.summary: Trust answer does not persist across sessions when using home folder as working directory on Windows.
aliases: trust not persisted on Windows home directory
signals.review_reason: Significant experience degradation: Users must manually approve trust for their home directory on every session, creating persistent friction for developers who use their home folder as a work directory.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Trust prompt re-appears every session for home directory (C:\Users\<username>)
source_issues.evidence: Trust answer does not persist across sessions when using home folder as working directory. Users must manually select trust option each session.

signals.topic: Skills cookbook入门指南缺少GitHub仓库克隆前提说明
signals.summary: skills-notebooks-01-skills-introduction页面指示用户执行「cd /path/to/claude-cookbooks/skills」，但未在 prerequisites 中说明需要先克隆GitHub仓库，导致用户无法开始学习流程。
aliases: missing git clone prerequisite in skills introduction notebook
signals.review_reason: Issue #557 描述了用户在尝试跟随 skills cookbook 教程时的完整阻断流程：页面要求 cd 到某个路径，但未告知该路径需通过克隆仓库获得，导致用户无法开始学习。标签为 bug，证据明确——用户在描述中明确表达了 frustration，是典型的文档缺失导致的主流程阻断，属于可复现的用户痛点。

source_issues.title: [BUG] intro to skills should point at github repo as install prereq
source_issues.evidence: 用户明确描述无法按照 cookbook 页面指示执行，根源是 prerequisites 部分缺少 git clone 这一前提步骤的说明，用户实际被阻断在入门第一步。

signals.topic: Telegram plugin: orphan watchdog PPID false-positive causes plugin to self-terminate and leak zombie processes
signals.summary: The Telegram plugin's orphan watchdog checks if process.ppid != bootPpid, but PPID changes normally when the bun/shell wrapper exits (OS reparents child to PID 1). This causes the plugin to self-terminate every ~5s in normal operation. Combined with missing EPIPE handling, terminated servers become CPU-burning zombies that accumulate across sessions.
signals.review_reason: Two distinct issues (#1467, #1500) sharing the same plugin and root cause: the PPID watchdog fires false positives on normal wrapper exit, and when servers do survive they become CPU-burning zombies. User impact is severe: plugin self-terminates in normal use, and zombie accumulation causes real hardware resource drain (250 CPU-hours/3 days). Both issues have detailed bug reports with repro steps and root cause analysis.

source_issues.title: telegram plugin: orphan watchdog false-positives on bun reparenting — plugin self-terminates every ~5s
source_issues.evidence: PPID check fires on every normal startup because bun/shell wrapper exits and OS reparents child to PID 1. Plugin self-terminates repeatedly. Verified with two-file Bun harness repro. Confirmed by user on macOS/Darwin 25.2.0.

source_issues.title: [telegram] Server leaks and pegs 100% CPU when Claude Code exits without SIGTERM-ing plugin
source_issues.evidence: When CC exits without signaling, bun server.ts survives (PPID reparented to launchd), then spins at 80-100% CPU indefinitely due to EPIPE busy-loop in exception swallowers. User observed 14 zombie processes, 250 CPU-hours burned in 3 days, load avg 40, fan at max on M4 Pro Mac mini.

signals.topic: Telegram plugin: MCP server fails to connect on Windows due to start script writing non-JSON to stdout during handshake
signals.summary: The telegram plugin's start script runs 'bun install' which writes non-JSON output to stdout during the MCP client's initial handshake window, causing the connection to drop. The fix is simple (move install to postinstall, redirect output to stderr, or pre-bundle deps) but has not been applied.
aliases: telegram plugin windows MCP failed to connect
telegram start script JSON-RPC handshake broken
signals.review_reason: MCP server completely fails to connect on Windows — the plugin's primary mechanism is unavailable. The root cause is clear (non-JSON stdout during handshake) and the fix is known. Users cannot use the Telegram channel on Windows at all after following official install instructions.

source_issues.title: [telegram] MCP server fails to connect on Windows — start script breaks JSON-RPC handshake
source_issues.evidence: On Windows 11, 'bun install' in package.json start script writes output to stdout during MCP handshake. MCP host expects clean JSON-RPC from byte 1. Verified: running bun server.ts standalone works (emits 'polling as @<MyBot>'), but via MCP client 'Failed to connect'. Same pattern observed in fakechat plugin. Workaround confirmed working by reporter.

signals.topic: security-guidance plugin: substring blocklist fires false positives on benign code and blocks legitimate Write/Edit operations
signals.summary: The security_reminder_hook.py uses overly broad substring matches (e.g. 'exec(' catches every RegExp.exec(), 'innerHTML =' catches anti-example code in docs) and exits with code 2 to hard-block the tool. Legitimate code and documentation containing anti-examples are blocked, eroding user trust in the block system.
signals.review_reason: The security-guidance plugin actively blocks legitimate Write/Edit tool calls in real user workflows (design docs, code examples, READMEs). The false positive rate is high enough in doc-heavy workflows that it erodes trust in the security system — users learn to ignore blocks. This is a main-flow blocking issue for users who write code documentation or discuss security topics.

source_issues.title: security-guidance: substring blocklist fires false positives (e.g. regex .exec() matches child_process_exec)
source_issues.evidence: Reporter documents multiple real false positive cases: RegExp.exec() triggers child_process_exec block, anti-pattern examples in design docs trigger new_function_injection, XSS discussion in README triggers innerHTML_xss. Tool invocation is rejected with exit code 2 and the reminder text. In agent-driven surfaces this surfaces as 'Some actions were blocked by policy: write, write'. High false-positive rate in doc-heavy workflows causes users to assume every block is a false positive, eroding the security signal.

signals.topic: M365 MCP connector: auth fails with misleading 'organization access policy blocks MCP server' error despite full admin consent
signals.summary: The Microsoft 365 MCP connector returns a misleading error claiming the tenant's access policy blocks the connection, even when no such policy exists and admin consent is fully granted. Sign-in logs show no failed auth attempt from Claude's service principals, suggesting the rejection originates from Anthropic's backend before reaching the tenant.
aliases: M365 MCP connector false error message
signals.review_reason: M365 connector is completely unusable for affected tenants. The error message is actively misleading — it directs IT admins to check tenant policies that don't exist, wasting time. Sign-in log evidence shows no auth attempt reaches the tenant, indicating the failure is on Anthropic's backend. This blocks the core integration for multiple users across at least two tenants.

source_issues.title: [BUG] M365 Connector — 'Your organization's access policy blocks the MCP server' despite admin consent granted
source_issues.evidence: M365 MCP connector fails on Claude.ai web/desktop and Claude Code CLI. Reporter has Global Admin consent for both M365 MCP Server and Client apps in Entra, no Conditional Access policies, no tenant restrictions. Entra sign-in logs show no failed auth attempt from Claude service principals — suggesting rejection originates at Anthropic's backend. Misleading error directs IT admins to check tenant policies that are not the cause. Reproduces consistently for all users in the tenant. Multiple tenants affected per linked Microsoft Q&A thread. Related issue #37969 was closed as 'not Claude Code related' but this error also surfaces in Claude Code.

signals.topic: remember plugin: save-session.sh path resolution ignores plugin env vars, causing silent session save failures
signals.summary: The remember plugin's save-session.sh derives its own paths from $0 instead of honoring CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR. When installed as a plugin, path resolution breaks and session saves fail silently — .remember/ never accumulates content beyond empty directories.
signals.review_reason: The remember plugin's core feature (saving session content) fails silently for all users who install via 'plugin install' — the officially documented method. The core deliverable of the plugin (.remember/ content files) never gets created. Users may not notice for a long time, making this a particularly insidious failure.

source_issues.title: remember v0.1.0: save-session.sh path resolution fails when run as plugin
source_issues.evidence: When installed as plugin (default path), save-session.sh resolves paths from $0 and lands in wrong directory. Errors: 'cd: No such file or directory', '[: : integer expression expected'. The .remember/ directory never accumulates any actual content (now.md, today-*.md) beyond auto-created logs/ and tmp/. No user-facing error — session saves silently fail. Hook wrappers correctly honor env vars, but save-session.sh overwrites them.

signals.topic: skill-creator Pro 订阅限制导致主流程完全不可用
signals.summary: Pro 用户反映 skill-creator 新引入的用量限制过严，导致无法完成任何编码任务，甚至无法完成基础的上下文配置，工具实质上已无法使用。
aliases: Pro subscription unusable due to limits
signals.review_reason: 用户明确报告 skill-creator 在 Pro 订阅下因新限制而完全不可用（'unusable'），主流程被阻断，无法完成编码任务。count=1，虽未达高频但有强用户影响证据，应为 P1。

source_issues.title: skill-creator eliminated the whole limits (5 hours x 2 times) without any result
source_issues.evidence: User explicitly states 'The skills-creator is unusable after your new limits!' with Pro subscription. User cannot code anything or even set up context via skills/agents/memory. Explicitly calls it 'impossible' and expresses being 'Very disappointed'.

signals.topic: run_eval.py 使用 claude -p 模式时 skills/commands 触发率为 0%，导致评估框架完全失效

signals.review_reason: run_eval.py 是 skill-creator 质量保障的核心评估流水线，其 skill 触发率为 0/3 意味着无法验证任何 skill 是否正常工作，测试结果完全不可信。这是工具质量保证的主流程被阻断。count=1 但有详尽的复现数据和高置信度分析，定 P1。

source_issues.title: run_eval.py: claude -p never triggers skills/commands (0% trigger rate across all queries)
source_issues.evidence: Bug report with reproducible evidence: 8 different skills tested, 144 total queries, every should-trigger query scored 0/3 triggers. Explicit 'run /lucas:memory-layer please' also scored 0/3. Analysis shows claude -p mode may not load skills/commands from .claude/commands/. 6 comments discussing the issue.

signals.topic: skill-creator eval 循环无实时进度反馈，用户长时间等待期间界面完全静默

aliases: run_loop.py blocks user with no output
signals.review_reason: eval 循环长时间静默导致用户体验显著下降，eval 崩溃时用户完全无感知，阻断调试流程。虽然是功能请求，但其核心描述的是真实 UX 痛点（静默等待 + 无错误可见性），符合痛点定义。

source_issues.title: feat(skill-creator): leverage Monitor tool for streaming eval progress
source_issues.evidence: Issue explicitly states 'the entire loop blocks in a single Bash call. The user sees nothing for minutes while 5 iterations of 10+ eval queries run in parallel. This is especially painful for description optimization where each iteration takes 30-60 seconds.' Also notes 'a crashloop or hung eval shows up as a notification, not as silence.'

signals.topic: Upgrade migration v10 panics on startup with existing sessions.db, orphaning all prior sessions
signals.summary: When upgrading from Goose 1.30.0 to 1.31.0, the schema migration v10 leaves all existing sessions with NULL thread_id and does not backfill the new threads/thread_messages tables. Goose 1.31.0 then panics on startup with 'index out of bounds' when it assumes every session has a corresponding thread row, making the application completely unusable for any user who has existing sessions.
aliases: Goose 1.31.0 startup panic with existing sessions
signals.review_reason: This is a confirmed P0: upgrading Goose to 1.31.0 causes a complete startup crash, making the application unusable for any user with prior sessions. The migration v10 bug leaves 52 sessions orphaned and all existing session history permanently lost unless users manually move the DB file. This is a workflow-critical data-loss scenario with explicit reproduction steps and SQL evidence.

source_issues.title: Goose 1.31.0 panics on startup with existing sessions.db from 1.30.0 (migration v10 orphans sessions)
source_issues.evidence: Verified: 52 sessions orphaned with NULL thread_id, 0 threads created. Panic occurs on fetch_one() when running query that assumes every session has a thread row. User loses all session history as workaround requires fresh DB.

signals.topic: Shell environment isolation prevents Goose from discovering system tools in Linux development environments
signals.summary: On Linux, Goose does not inherit the parent shell's exported PATH and environment variables, causing the agent to fail to find tools managed by version managers (pyenv, venv, nvm, conda, poetry) that are available in the parent terminal session. The agent operates in a stripped-down environment, making it unusable for typical development workflows.
aliases: Goose does not inherit PATH from parent shell on Linux
Environment variables not inherited in Linux
pyenv/venv tools not found by Goose agent
signals.review_reason: This is a P0 workflow blocker: on Linux, Goose's shell environment isolation means development tools (Python, Node, pyenv, conda, poetry) are completely unavailable to the agent, even when started from a terminal where these tools are fully accessible. This blocks the primary development use case for a large class of Linux users.

source_issues.title: Shell environment isolation: Goose fails to inherit exported PATH and variables in Linux
source_issues.evidence: User reports Python unavailable to Goose agent even when active in parent terminal with pyenv/venv. Agent reports 'Python is not installed on your system.' Debug env command reveals minimal environment lacking parent session's paths. All common Linux dev tooling (pyenv, conda, poetry) completely broken.

signals.topic: Context compaction triggers prematurely and fails unrecoverably on sessions with low actual token usage
signals.summary: Goose falsely reports the context window as full at 9-14% actual usage, triggering auto-compaction. The compaction summarization call then also exceeds the limit and fails, leaving the session in an unrecoverable state. This is caused by a token counter bug that affects even brand-new sessions.
aliases: Token counter bug causes false context-full errors
Context window indicator inconsistency at low usage
signals.review_reason: This is a P1: a token counter bug causes premature compaction triggering at 9-14% context usage, with the compaction call itself then failing due to the same miscalculation. The session becomes unrecoverable and users cannot continue their work. This is a session-state issue that disrupts core usage, though it is not a complete startup blocker.

source_issues.title: Context limit reached + compaction failure on sessions that haven't exceeded context
source_issues.evidence: Compaction fires at 9-14% context usage (per issue #3606). Both auto-compaction and manual compact fail. Root cause is token counter miscalculation causing false 'context full' state, leading to summarization call also exceeding limit. Session enters unrecoverable state. Starting new session does not always resolve.

signals.topic: Streaming response parser fails with 'missing field delta' on Azure OpenAI and similar providers
signals.summary: When using Azure OpenAI/GPT models, Goose fails to parse streaming responses because the API returns chunks without the expected 'delta' field (Azure uses a different schema). This causes request failures and breaks the main interaction flow for affected providers.
aliases: Azure OpenAI streaming chunk parse error
Failed to parse streaming chunk missing field delta
Goose fails on Azure OpenAI streaming responses
signals.review_reason: This is a P1: Azure OpenAI provider users cannot complete requests because Goose fails to parse the streaming response format. The main interaction loop is broken for this provider, representing a workflow runtime failure.

source_issues.title: Ran into this error: Request failed: Failed to parse streaming chunk: missing field delta
source_issues.evidence: Azure OpenAI/GPT 5.4 returns streaming chunks with 'content_filter_offsets' but without 'delta' field, causing 'Failed to parse streaming chunk: missing field delta' error. Goose crashes mid-request on this provider.

signals.topic: Installation script fails on WSL2 when run from a Windows-mounted drive
signals.summary: The download_cli.sh installation script incorrectly detects the OS as Windows when running from a Windows-mounted directory within WSL2, downloading the Windows binary and using Windows configuration paths, causing installation to fail silently or incorrectly.
aliases: WSL2 OS detection fails on mounted drives
signals.review_reason: This is a P2: installation fails for WSL2 users with mounted drive setups. While blocking for the specific environment, it only affects a subset of WSL2 users (those with mounted drives) and does not impact CLI users who install via standard methods.

source_issues.title: Installation script incorrectly detects Windows OS when running from WSL2 inside a mounted drive
source_issues.evidence: Script defaults to Windows build (goose-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip) and attempts to install .exe in a Linux binary path from WSL2. Uses Windows config paths (AppData\Roaming) despite uname -s reporting Linux.

signals.topic: Cloudflare-protected sites fail to load — browser stuck at about:blank with internal Stagehand errors
signals.summary: Stagehand v2.4.1 无法自动化 Cloudflare 保护的站点（以 jiji.ng 为例）：浏览器停留在 about:blank，observe/act 调用时抛出内部错误（Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'replace') 和 StagehandError: Invalid argument: you may have called act with an empty ObserveResult），导致主流程完全阻断。
aliases: Cloudflare bot detection blocks browser automation
Browser stuck at about:blank on protected sites
signals.review_reason: 这是真实的用户阻断性问题：用户在尝试自动化 Cloudflare 保护的主流电商/分类站（jiji.ng）时，主流程完全失败，浏览器停留在 about:blank 不导航，且 Stagehand 内部抛出未捕获异常（undefined replace），用户体验为空白浏览器窗口+控制台错误。虽然仅 1 条 issue，但影响明确（主流程阻断 + 内部崩溃），非边缘问题，应保留为 P1。

source_issues.title: Stagehand Issue: Unable to Automate Cloudflare-blocked sites (Blank Browser, and Internal Errors)
source_issues.evidence: 浏览器窗口停留在 about:blank，未导航到目标页；observe/act 调用时抛出 Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'replace') 和 StagehandError: Invalid argument；主流程（自动化受保护站点）完全阻断。

signals.topic: Docker 部署启动时卡住，流程阻断
signals.summary: 用户通过 Docker 部署 DeerFlow 时，运行到某一步骤后卡住无法继续，主流程被完全阻断。
signals.review_reason: 用户实际部署流程被阻断，Docker 容器启动后在运行时阶段卡住无法推进，主流程完全不可用。虽然只有单条 issue，但部署阻断直接影响用户上手，证据明确（截图+明确阻塞描述）。归类为 P1 而非 P0 因 count=1。

source_issues.title: docker部署时，运行到这里就卡住
source_issues.evidence: 用户通过 make docker-start 部署 Docker，运行时在某一阶段卡住不动，主流程完全阻断，无法继续使用 DeerFlow。

signals.topic: LLM 请求返回 400 错误导致任务无法完成
signals.summary: LLM 请求直接返回 400 错误，错误信息表明消息流中缺少必需的 tool message，任务流程被阻断。
signals.review_reason: LLM 请求失败返回 400 是明确的运行时阻断错误，导致 agent 任务无法完成。错误信息揭示了内部消息状态管理问题，用户无法正常使用 AI 推理能力。

source_issues.title: LLM request failed: Error code: 400
source_issues.evidence: LLM 请求返回 HTTP 400，错误信息为 'An assistant message with tool_calls must be followed by tool messages responding to each tool_call_id'，表明消息流状态异常，任务无法正常完成。

signals.topic: LLM 请求频繁出现 'Event loop is closed' 错误
signals.summary: 用户在实际使用中频繁遭遇 Event loop is closed 错误，导致任务无法正常完成，反复失败。

source_issues.title: LLM request failed: Event loop is closed

signals.topic: macOS 上 make dev 因 C.UTF-8 locale 缺失导致 perl panic 启动超时
signals.summary: 在 macOS 环境下运行 make dev 时，scripts/serve.sh 中的 perl 管道因缺少 C.UTF-8 locale 而 panic，导致 LangGraph 启动超时，主流程无法启动。
signals.review_reason: macOS 开发者本地启动流程完全阻断，perl 因缺少 C.UTF-8 locale 而 panic 导致 LangGraph 60 秒超时。问题有明确的根因定位和完整复现步骤，是典型的跨平台兼容性问题。

source_issues.title: make dev fails on macOS due to C.UTF-8 locale in scripts/serve.sh (perl panic)

signals.topic: LocalSandboxProvider 挂载目录后无法在对话中正常使用
signals.summary: 用户在 sandbox 配置中通过 mounts 挂载了主机目录（如 /home/anaconda3/envs/test 到 /mnt/test_env），但在对话中访问挂载路径时报错 'Unsafe absolute paths in command'，被强制限制在 /mnt/user-data 下，核心功能不可用。

source_issues.title: LocalSandboxProvider 挂载后 没法在对话中使用
